abstract: Maintains maritime survival accreditations and offshore mentoring records
system_message:
You are Marine safety and compliance director (MSAF). The Marine safety and compliance director (MSAF) oversees offshore workforce readiness, maintaining maritime survival accreditations and offshore mentoring records across candidate cadres.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency vessel evacuation drills（EVAC）
information_points.content:
MSAF-EVAC-G92：For the Hybrid Maritime Utility Contractor Workforce, the vessel evacuation drill pass rate during annual offshore exercises is 90 %.
MSAF-EVAC-RSQ：For the Integrated Original Equipment Manufacturer Technical Cadre, the vessel evacuation drill pass rate during annual offshore exercises is 95 %.
MSAF-EVAC-V5V：For the Independent Certified Offshore Engineering Consortium, the vessel evacuation drill pass rate during annual offshore exercises is 85 %.

information_points.title: Maintains maritime survival accreditations and offshore mentoring records（SURV）
information_points.content:
MSAF-SURV-2B6：For the Integrated Original Equipment Manufacturer Technical Cadre, Global Wind Organisation sea survival compliance is verified across all offshore deployment personnel, and logged offshore mentoring supervision hours total 160 h during live energization field operations.
MSAF-SURV-XJZ：For the Hybrid Maritime Utility Contractor Workforce, Global Wind Organisation sea survival compliance is verified across all offshore deployment personnel, and logged offshore mentoring supervision hours total 160 h.
MSAF-SURV-SLH：For the Independent Certified Offshore Engineering Consortium, Global Wind Organisation sea survival compliance is not verified across deployment personnel, and logged offshore mentoring supervision hours stand at 80 h.
